estimate-cell.reader: the client's and our own project managers reading an estimate table
rules: A cell is a short noun phrase at the same level of detail as the source cell beside it.

A work-item cell names the object and the change: which screen / button / process, and what it becomes. A cell that only says 「〜への対応」, 「〜追加」, 「〜チェック」, 'support X', 'add X' without saying what changes is `vague`.
The translated cell carries every detail of the source cell (screen names, conditions, destinations); a detail dropped or changed is `mismatch`.
Abbreviations that are in the project glossary are allowed in a cell; other abbreviations are `abbreviation`.
estimate-cell.basis: skills/estimation/SKILL.md step 6 (short noun phrases in the cell); work items written only as 「〜への対応」 do not say what changes; expanding glossary abbreviations inside a cell breaks the table's density

text.reader: the stated reader, who has not read the source documents
rules: Full sentences; no abbreviations — every company, system and term written in full.
text.basis: config/wording-review.md (the plugin's wording standard) and rule 4 of the CLAUDE.md block written by brse.py init
